'''Ganner Four''' was [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] designation in [[Second Galactic Civil War]] during [[Battle of Corellia (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Corellia]]. She served there as a part of the informal [[Ganner Squadron]].
